as ''Shoqëria Sportive Vllaznia'' (Vllaznia Sports Society) | ground = [[Loro Boriçi Stadium]] | capacity = 16,000{{cite web|url=http://www.worldstadiums.com/europe/countries/albania.shtml|title=World Stadiums – Stadiums in Albania|access-date=30 July 2010|publisher=World Stadiums}} | chrtitle = President | chairman = Alban Xhaferi | manager = [[Csaba László (footballer, born 1964)|Csaba László]] | league = [[Kategoria Superiore]] | season = [[2025–26 Kategoria Superiore|2025–26]] | website = {{URL|vllaznia.al}} | position = [[Kategoria Superiore]], 3rd | pattern_la1 = _vllaznia2324hh | pattern_b1 = _vllaznia2324h | pattern_ra1 = _vllaznia2324hh | pattern_so1 = | pattern_sh1 = | leftarm1 = 000d4e | body1 = ff1900 | rightarm1 = ff1900 | shorts1 = 000d4e | socks1 = 000A3f | pattern_la2 = _vllaznia2122a | pattern_ra2 = _vllaznia2122a | pattern_b2 = _vllaznia2122a | pattern_sh2 = _vllaznia2122a | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = ffffff | body2 = ffffff | rightarm2 = ffffff | shorts2 = ffffff | socks2 = ffffff | pattern_la3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_b3 = _vllaznia2324t | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = 000000 | body3 = 000000 | rightarm3 = 000000 | shorts3 = 000000 | socks3 = 000000 }} {{KF Vllaznia Shkodër branches}} '''Klubi i Futbollit Vllaznia''', commonly known as '''Vllaznia''', is an Albanian [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Shkodër]]. It is the association football branch of the Vllaznia Sports Club, which was founded on 16 February 1919. It is also the oldest club in [[Albania]] which means it is the first club created in [[Albania]]. The club have competed in every edition of [[Kategoria Superiore]] since 1930, which is the top tier of football in Albania, besides in the 1956–57, 1961–62 and 2018–19 football seasons. Vllaznia is one of the most successful football clubs in Albania, having won nine [[Kategoria Superiore]] titles, eight [[Albanian Cup]]s and two [[Albanian Supercup]]s. They have only been relegated from the [[Kategoria Superiore]] three times in 1956 due to a disqualification, in 1961, and for the last time in decades in 2018. The club's ground has been the [[Loro Boriçi Stadium]] since it was built in 1952, which is named after former Vllaznia and [[Albania national football team|Albania national team]] captain. In 2016, the stadium was rebuilt into modern [[All-seater stadium|all-seater]] at the cost of €17 million, and it now has a capacity of 16,022, making it the second largest stadium in Albania.{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}"}}
